note: Document-grounded invariants per tariff: facts the source documents actually state, and the ones they deliberately do NOT (premium, chosen Stufe -> must stay null). The hand-curated ground-truth proxy the heuristic eval lacks; scripts/regression.py asserts every out/tariffs/*.json against these and exits non-zero on any violation. Keyed by the out/tariffs/<key>.json filename stem (manifest-derived, stable across models). Each invariant was verified against the actual fed source text -- included-flags are pinned ONLY for modules that are unconditionally CORE (not optional/'wenn vereinbart' bausteine, not Leistungsarten embedded in another module), so a faithful extraction can never trip a false alarm. Every module's level is pinned null regardless of inclusion: that guards against Stufe hallucination and passes trivially when a module is absent. check kinds: eq | nonnull | isnull | contains | contains_all_digits | in.
